title: montiastrum howellii
intro: Montiastrum howellii, commonly known as Howell's catchfly, is a flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Montiastrum howellii include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in reducing swelling, relieving fever, and facilitating the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
